verdict.rationale: While Tailscale is plausibly capable of scoped credentialing (tags, ACL policy, API keys) since it's an infrastructure/networking product, the evidence pack has no documentation of least-privilege or scoped API credential issuance tailored for an AI agent — only a passing community mention that API keys expire after 60 days, with no detail on scoping mechanisms or agent-specific use. missing for 10: docs on OAuth client scopes/ACL-tag restricted auth keys, any explicit agent-credentialing workflow, and independent confirmation of least-privilege enforcement.
